**Help turn P&C plans into action

**Do you enjoy creating structure, improving processes, and making things happen?

We are looking for a People & Culture Operations Partner to join Caljan for a 12-month maternity cover. You will play an important role in developing our global P&C Operations, with a particular focus on HR systems, digital solutions, data, governance, policies, and process improvements.

Working from our Hasselager office, you will collaborate with P&C colleagues across our international organization, including colleagues in Denmark, Germany, the UK, Latvia, and the US. The direction is set, but we need someone who can turn priorities into practical plans and drive activities forward.

**What will you do?

**You will take ownership of agreed P&C initiatives and help ensure they are successfully implemented across the organization.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Coordinating the implementation and optimization of HR systems and digital solutions

• Turning priorities into structured plans and following activities through to completion

• Improving HR data quality and reporting

• Supporting the development and implementation of global P&C processes, policies, and governance

• Identifying opportunities to simplify workflows and improve the way we work

• Collaborating with P&C, IT, external partners, and colleagues across countries

You will work with systems such as HR-Connect, D365, and Intempus and contribute to both new solutions and improvements to existing workflows.

**Who are we looking for?

**You have practical experience within HR Operations, HR administration, HR projects, or a similar HR role and enjoy combining structure with action.

We imagine that you:

• Have a good understanding of HR processes and employee data

• Are comfortable working with digital tools and learning new systems

• Can coordinate stakeholders and keep activities moving forward

• Work independently and take ownership from start to finish

• Are structured and detail-oriented without overcomplicating things

• Enjoy finding practical solutions in a dynamic environment

• Communicate professionally in Danish and English

Experience with HR system implementations or an international organization is an advantage, but not a requirement. More importantly, you are curious, proactive, collaborative, and ready to turn ideas into action.

**Why join Caljan?

**At Caljan, you will join an international organization where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work. You will become part of an experienced P&C team while having the independence to organize your work and drive your own deliverables.

During your 12 months with us, you will have the opportunity to contribute to tangible improvements in our global P&C Operations and gain experience working across countries, systems, and functions.

We offer pension and private health insurance, as well as lunch, fresh fruit, and social activities at our Hasselager location.

**About Caljan

**At Caljan, we create solutions that make logistics safer, smarter, and more efficient. Our equipment and technology help companies around the world improve the way goods are loaded, unloaded, and moved through their operations.

But Caljan is also about the people behind the solutions. We are an international organization with a practical, down-to-earth culture where collaboration, responsibility, and new ideas are valued. Across countries and functions, we work together to improve, simplify, and make things happen.

**Practical information

**

• Location: Hasselager, Denmark

• Working hours: 37 hours per week

• Contract: 12-month maternity cover

• Preferred start: As soon as possible

• Workplace: Primarily on-site, with occasional flexibility when needed

• Travel: Occasional international travel may be required

**Want to know more?

**Curious about the role, the team, or working at Caljan? We would be happy to hear from you.

Please contact Rebecca Moth Madsen, Group People & Culture Operations Manager, at rebecca.madsen@caljan.com

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us in shaping the future of offshore wind. As our Traverse Equipment Owner, you will serve as the technical authority and lifecycle owner for traverse equipment used in offshore installation and servicing operations. You will be responsible for ensuring equipment performance, reliability, safety, and long-term value across a global fleet.

Working at the intersection of engineering, operations, project execution, suppliers, and management, you will play a key role in aligning diverse stakeholder needs and translating them into clear requirements, priorities, and improvement initiatives. Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management capabilities, sound technical judgement, and the ability to balance operational, commercial, and safety considerations.

You will drive the development of the traverse equipment roadmap, monitor fleet performance, and lead continuous improvement efforts throughout the equipment lifecycle. By fostering collaboration, standardization, and the adoption of new technologies, you will help ensure that our traverse solutions continue to support safe and efficient offshore operations worldwide.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Own the traverse equipment lifecycle, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, safety, and long-term business value.

• Translate operational and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, success criteria, and approved improvement initiatives.

• Develop and maintain the traverse equipment roadmap and prioritized backlog, including technology development and investment needs.

• Monitor fleet performance, assess incidents and lessons learned, and drive corrective actions, upgrades, and risk mitigation measures.

• Promote knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and the adoption of innovative technologies across the Equipment organization.

What You Bring

• An Engineering degree (Mechanical, Marine, Civil, Industrial, or similar) and at least 10 years of technical experience in equipment development, maintenance, or asset management within offshore wind or a comparable heavy-industry environment.

• Proven experience with traverse systems, lifting equipment, stabilization systems, motion control technologies, or other equipment used for offshore heavy-load handling.

• Demonstrated experience in equipment ownership, technical leadership, or lifecycle management of complex engineered products.

• Ability to convert operational challenges and user feedback into technical requirements, validation criteria, and improvement plans.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach.

About the Team

You will join a global team responsible for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of specialized offshore equipment. The team combines operational experience with engineering expertise to ensure equipment reliability, safety, and efficiency throughout its lifecycle. Together, we drive innovation, standardization, and best practices that support offshore wind projects worldwide.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

A Snapshot of Your Day

You will join the Optimization & Validation team within the Turbine Control department, supporting the team in updating the wind turbine controller software for different turbine platforms.

Once a turbine platform is updated, you will use BHawC, our in-house aeroelastic wind turbine simulation code, to simulate the new controller. Then, using our MATLAB-based engineering tools, you will compare the new controller version with the previous one. You will review key turbine responses to verify that the turbine behaves as expected and identify any unexpected or unusual behavior.

Working closely with experienced colleagues, you will investigate differences between controller versions and help understand the reasons behind them. This will give you hands-on experience with wind turbine control, aeroelastic simulation, MATLAB-based engineering tools and controller validation, while contributing directly to the controller software used across our turbine platforms.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• 
You will maintain and update wind turbine models using MATLAB scripts, ensuring they align with engineering specifications.

• 
Simulate turbine behavior using BHawC.

• 
Analyze simulations to identify unexpected turbine behaviour and investigate the underlying causes.

• 
Ensure the quality of the controller updates by validating that the turbine behaves as expected across different operating conditions.

• 
Update and optimize MATLAB and Python scripts for generating turbine simulation reports.

• 
Generate detailed technical reports on turbine behavior using specialized tools and LaTeX, aiding in the tuning of turbine controllers.

• 
Contribute to our engineering toolbox by improving our existing tools or developing new ones.

• 
Maintain a list of the updated turbines in Jira.

What You Bring

• 
Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree programme in Wind Energy, Mechanical, Control, Aeronautical Engineering or a similar discipline, preferably with at least 1.5 years remaining.

• 
Experience or academic coursework in MATLAB and Python, particularly in programming, data processing, analysis, visualisation and engineering simulations.

• 
Solid understanding of wind energy engineering principles, control systems and mechanical/aeronautical engineering concepts.

• 
Proficiency in LaTeX for document preparation, technical report writing and simulation data interpretation.

• 
Experience with Git for version control of engineering tools and scripts.

• 
Strong critical thinking skills to analyse plots and detect outliers, ensuring the quality of each software version.

• 
Knowledge of BHawC or HawC2 would be an advantage but is not a requirement.

• 
Familiarity with Jira to keep track of the progress of your work.

• 
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken, as it is the primary language of our business.

About the Team

The Optimization & Validation team is part of the Turbine Control Department within R&D, consisting of six full-time employees and two student assistants based in a new office in Ballerup, Denmark. We are proud to be an international team with colleagues from four continents: North America, Europe, Africa, and Asia. Our team plays a key role in offshore wind turbine development projects, scoping and tuning controllers using BHawC simulations, supporting certification activities, coordinating controller changes with the Software Department, and discussing simulation results with Turbine Loads and component design teams. As projects progress towards prototype testing, we perform extensive validation activities, ensuring turbine and controller performance matches simulation predictions. Much of this work is based on data collected from our offshore turbines installed in Østerild. We encourage open technical discussions and value diverse engineering perspectives, welcoming constructive disagreement to identify problems and reach better technical decisions.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer for advanced process solutions
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop technical process solutions for customers across the world and play a key role in transforming customer requirements into competitive and reliable industrial systems? Then this could be your next position.

On behalf of Simatek A/S, we are looking for a Process Engineer who will become a central technical resource in the company's Process & Proposal team and contribute to the continued development of customer-specific process solutions for industries worldwide.

About Simatek

Simatek A/S is an international engineering company specializing in air filtration, pneumatic conveying, dust handling, and process solutions for industries such as food, feed, grain, recycling, minerals, and industrial manufacturing. The company designs and delivers customized systems that help customers improve operational efficiency, product quality, environmental performance, and workplace safety. From its headquarters in Albertslund in Denmark, Simatek serves customers around the world and combines strong engineering expertise with a flexible and customer-oriented approach.

The position

As Process & Application Engineer, you will become part of Simatek's international Process & Proposal team with colleagues in both Denmark and India. Focusing primarily on solutions for the food, dairy, feed and grain industries, you will transform customer requirements into technically robust and commercially competitive process solutions.

Working closely with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will perform process calculations, size equipment, define system configurations and contribute to the development of tailored solutions that balance technical performance, cost efficiency and customer needs.

Your responsibilities will include

• Develop process solutions based on customer requirements and application data, identifying and solving technical issues in the process design

• Perform process calculations and system sizing for complete process installations

• Prepare and review process documentation

• Collaborate with suppliers regarding technical specifications and equipment selection

• Prepare technical proposals and quotations

• Contribute to the development and standardization of engineering tools, methods and solutions

• Work closely with R&D and the product management team to develop competitive solutions

• Support continuous improvement of process design standards and engineering practices

• Participate in occasional international travel for customer and technical meetings (approx. 20 days per year)

Your profile

We imagine you have a strong engineering background and experience developing process systems or technical solutions within industrial environments.

You likely bring:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree within Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline

• Experience within process engineering, system design or industrial solution development, with the ability to independently drive technical tasks

• Skilled in process calculations, equipment sizing and can read PFD and P&ID drawings

• Experience in preparing technical proposals, quotations or engineering project documentation is an advantage

• Experience from the food and dairy industry will be considered an advantage

• Professional proficiency in English. An additional language will be considered an advantage

As a person, you are analytical, solution-oriented and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You work in a structured manner, take ownership of your tasks and enjoy collaborating across technical and commercial disciplines.

Why join Simatek?

You will join an entrepreneurial organization where the distance from idea to implementation is short, allowing you to make a tangible impact.

The role offers:

• Flexible working conditions including the possibility of working from home, up to two days per week by agreement

• Attractive compensation package including pension scheme, health insurance and performance bonus

• An active social environment and employee association arranging events throughout the year

Interested?

Send your application and CV via the application button. We look forward to hearing from you.

For more information, you are very welcome to contact Senior Business Consultant Erik Bernskov at erik.bernskov@actief-hartmanns.dk or by phone at +45 41 21 13 29. All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

Actief Hartmanns manages the entire recruitment process on behalf of Simatek A/S, and all contact regarding the position should therefore be directed to us. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion or nationality.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been identified.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Ready to shape how Boozt grows and develops one of its most important departments across markets?

We are looking for a Marketing Manager for a maternity cover of approximately 13 months to lead the marketing agenda for our Kids department.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of customer insight, commercial priorities, Buying strategy and marketing. You will help define what Kids should stand for at Boozt, identify the categories, themes and moments we should prioritise, and translate these into a strong marketing plan across our markets.

You will work closely with Buying & Merchandising, our market and campaign teams and specialist functions across CRM, E-commerce, Media, Brand & Creative and Social to ensure that the right Kids priorities are brought to market in the right way.

This is a role for a commercially strong marketer who combines strategic thinking with a practical understanding of what it takes to create relevant, high-performing marketing in a fast-moving e-commerce environment.

**What You Will Do

**You will be responsible for developing and continuously strengthening the Kids marketing agenda.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Own the Kids marketing plan and positioning, defining the key categories, themes and customer opportunities to prioritise throughout the year, based on commercial performance, customer insight, seasonality and Buying strategy.

• Work closely with Buying & Merchandising to ensure that assortment priorities, strategic category opportunities, launches and relevant brand initiatives are translated into strong customer-facing marketing opportunities.

• Drive the Kids agenda across markets and campaigns, adapting priorities with the market/GTM team to reflect local customer needs, commercial potential and seasonality, while ensuring Kids is represented in larger Boozt campaigns with the right categories and propositions.

• Set the direction for customer-facing marketing partnering with Campaign Leads, E-commerce, CRM, Media, Brand & Creative and Social to translate Kids priorities into relevant campaigns, onsite experiences, customer journeys and content. You own the commercial direction and priorities, while specialist teams drive execution.

• Own performance and continuous improvement, using data and customer insights to measure impact, identify growth opportunities, challenge existing plans and strengthen the Kids marketing agenda.

**How The Role Works

**You will be the **marketing owner for the Kids department.

****This Means You Are Accountable For Defining

**

• what Marketing should prioritise within Kids

• why those priorities matter

• when they are relevant

• which markets they matter in

• what commercial or customer outcome they should deliver

**YOUR PROFILE

**We are looking for someone who combines strong commercial judgement with a genuine understanding of customers, categories and marketing. You know how to turn insights into clear priorities and bring people together around opportunities that drive business results.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• At least 5 years of experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer marketing, preferably within fashion, kidswear or a related category.

• Strong commercial understanding, connecting customer behaviour, category performance, seasonality and marketing opportunities.

• Experience developing marketing strategies and plans, translating business and customer insights into clear priorities and actionable initiatives.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with performance data. Experience with Qlik Sense, Google Analytics or similar tools is an advantage.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to challenge constructively, make clear recommendations and prioritise across Buying, commercial, creative and digital teams.

• Strong marketing judgement, a high quality bar and a structured, proactive approach, combined with the flexibility to navigate a fast-moving environment.

• Fluency in English, our company language.

**WHY JOIN NOW?

**Boozt is evolving how Marketing works across markets, departments and specialist teams.

This role therefore offers the opportunity not only to lead the Kids marketing agenda during the maternity-cover period, but also to contribute to how we build a stronger, more commercially focused and more market-relevant marketing organisation going forward.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• Driven and passionate international colleagues

• A generous employee discount

• Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

jobs.occupation: Data Science Student in Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
**Data Science Student in Strategy & Transformation

Who We Are

**NNIT is a niche specialist in IT for life sciences and highly regulated industries. We help pharma, biotech and medtech companies across Europe, the US and Asia, as well as public sector and regulated customers in Denmark, solve their most complex challenges where technology, regulation and business critical processes meet.

We are in the middle of a fundamental transformation. Our strategy, OneNNIT 2030, sets out how we will sharpen our position as a niche specialist, reshape our portfolio into a focused set of value pathways that take customers from advisory through implementation to managed services, bring our US and European organisations together as one, and become a genuinely AI-driven company.

The Strategy & Transformation Office leads that journey. It reports directly to our CEO, owns NNIT's strategy cycle, runs the transformation programme and builds the capabilities that will carry the momentum through to 2030. We are now building the team, and we are looking for a Data Science Student who wants to work at the heart of it.

**What You Will Do

**You will be part of the analytical engine in the Strategy & Transformation Office. Every major decision in our transformation needs a solid fact base, and every initiative needs to show that it delivers. You will help build both, and your work will land directly with our CEO and Executive Management.

You are comfortable with code and data, and just as interested in what the numbers mean for the business. You are AI savvy, and you are curious about the bigger picture of how AI transforms organisations, ways of working and business models.

**Typical tasks include

**▪ Building the fact base behind OneNNIT 2030, from portfolio and revenue analysis to customer, market and capability data

▪ Designing and maintaining the KPIs, dashboards and benefit tracking that show Executive Management and the Board how the transformation is progressing

▪ Modelling revenue, margin and demand across offerings and geographies as we consolidate our portfolio into value pathways

▪ Combining data from finance, sales, delivery and HR systems into analyses that inform strategic decisions

▪ Identifying, sizing and prioritising AI use cases across our offerings, delivery model and internal processes, and tracking AI adoption across NNIT

▪ Building prototypes and analytical tools in Python, SQL or Power BI, and using generative AI to work faster and smarter

▪ Turning analysis into clear insights and material for workshops, leadership meetings and strategy sessions

**What You Will Bring

****We imagine that you

**▪ Are preferably in the third year of your Bachelor's degree, or in the first year of your Master’s degree, for example in Business ▪ Administration and Data Science or Digital Management at Copenhagen Business School

▪ Have a strong interest in data science, AI, strategy and business transformation

▪ Are curious about how data and AI change decisions, organisations and value creation

▪ Are analytical and structured, and able to turn complex data into clear insights that non-specialists can act on

▪ Have hands-on experience with Python and SQL, and with Power BI or a similar tool, alongside strong Excel and PowerPoint skills

▪ Communicate clearly and professionally in Danish and English, both written and spoken

▪ Take initiative, have a strong eye for quality, handle confidential information with discretion and enjoy working with senior stakeholders

**What We Offer

**You will join the Strategy & Transformation Office, which reports directly to the CEO, and work closely with the Head of Strategy & Transformation. You will have a front-row seat as NNIT redefines its strategy, organisation and portfolio, and you will work alongside Executive Management, senior leaders across Europe, the US and Asia, and our external advisors.

You will get real responsibility from day one, high exposure to senior leadership and the flexibility to balance work with your studies. Few student jobs offer a closer view of how strategy and transformation are done in practice.

**Practical Information

**The role is 15 to 20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams.

Please upload your CV and cover letter in English. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon.

**About NNIT

**NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively work to eliminate bias and ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone has the right to be seen and heard as they are. We invite interested candidates to apply, no matter their background.

In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request candidates to refrain from including their pictures in their applications.

Learn more about working at NNIT

Apply now and liberate your talent!

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

Worklinq is looking for an energetic and results-driven Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition and accelerate our growth in the HR tech B2B SaaS market. In this role, you will be at the forefront of expanding our market presence, managing end-to-end sales processes from qualified opportunities through to closed contracts, and building strong relationships with enterprise decision-makers. You will work closely with multiple internal functions, including marketing, sales development and delivery, to turn commercial opportunities into long-term customers.

Key responsibilities

• End-to-end sales: Drive deals through the full cycle, from qualified meetings and solution demonstrations to final negotiation and signing.

• Modern sales execution: Use modern sales and AI tools to streamline prospect research, elevate message quality, and shorten sales cycles.

• Pipeline creation: Prospect into target enterprise accounts via outbound outreach, supplemented by handling qualified inbound leads.

• Commercial collaboration: Partner with marketing and delivery teams to ensure strong lead conversion and seamless handovers to customer onboarding.

Professional qualifications

• Track record in B2B SaaS: Experience running and closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles.

• Consultative selling: Ability to navigate enterprise buying committees, uncover business pain points, and articulate software value.

• Contract & negotiation skills: Hands-on experience structuring commercial proposals and negotiating contracts with decision-makers.

Personal qualifications

• High drive & grit, motivated by target achievement, disciplined, and resilient through longer sales cycles.

• Strong communicator, capable of establishing trust, active listening, and clear communication with executive stakeholders.

• Proactive mindset with a high sense of ownership over your own pipeline and results.

• Curious & collaborative, quick to grasp complex industry workflows and eager to contribute to team learning.

• Enjoys working across teams, bringing together diverse expertise, including professional services, to create momentum and drive successful outcomes throughout the customer journey.

What we offer

Worklinq is in the midst of an exciting transformation, taking our Workforce Management platform forward as a modern cloud-based SaaS solution for large enterprises across the Nordics and Europe.

To succeed on this journey, we build our culture around four core values: Customer-centric, United, Transparent, and Innovative, which guide how we treat each other, our customers, and our partners every day.

From our headquarters in Denmark, you will work closely with colleagues in Sweden, Norway, the UK, and Romania. We have an informal tone, flat decision-making structures, and a collaborative team spirit. We know that strong results begin with people who thrive and grow. That is why we prioritise professional knowledge-sharing, a strong sense of community, and social gatherings both locally and across borders once or twice a year.

Ready to make an impact?

In this role, you will be part of a five-person Sales and Marketing team, reporting directly to the CCO.

Curious about the role, our culture, or how we hire? We’d love to chat. Reach out to Head of People & Culture Anne Heiberg, ah@worklinq.com.

About the role

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

Initially, your focus will be on talent acquisition. Once core hiring is under way, you will gradually take on more of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, with support from external HR partners. HR at Sparrow Quantum is a function under development, and the role will grow with it, with a path towards Head of HR.

Responsibilities

Core responsibilities - leading talent acquisition

• 
Own the full recruitment process, from role definition with hiring managers to offer and contract-signing

• 
Source and attract candidates for specialist roles in quantum photonics, engineering, and production, as well as business functions

• 
Work with our Communications & Marketing Manager on building our employer brand and a talent pipeline, including attending job fairs at local and international universities

• 
Own our applicant tracking system, and report on hiring progress and time to hire

• 
Manage recruitment agencies, where they add value

• 
Coordinate with our Office & Admin Manager on work permits and relocation for international hires

• 
Source scientists and engineers through academic networks, conferences, and research groups, and run technical screening together with hiring managers

Career growth - HR across the employee life cycle

• 
Design onboarding that integrates new colleagues quickly

• 
Own retention initiatives, including employee surveys and follow-up on the results

• 
Support on building performance reviews and development paths for our employees

• 
Run offboarding, including exit interviews and knowledge handover

• 
Be the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions

• 
Keep contracts, policies, and HR documentation compliant with Danish employment law

Building the function

• 
Prioritize which HR processes, policies, and tools to build first as the company scales

• 
Manage our collaboration with external HR partners

• 
Advise management on workforce planning, organization ,and compensation, together with the VP of Finance

Who we are looking for

You are an HR professional with a strong recruitment profile, and you want to grow into or take on a broader HR role. If you don't already have experience within quantum or deep tech, then you should have a keen eye and an ability to learn quickly, so you can help find the best candidates for our team. And you should be excited by the prospect of being part of a company that's on a growth journey, where each day is often different from the next.

Must-haves

• 
2 to 6 years of experience in HR, with a clear focus on recruitment

• 
A clear wish to broaden into HR, from onboarding and development to offboarding

• 
Working knowledge of Danish employment law and practice

• 
A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• 
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

• 
Experience within deep tech, research, or tech, and at a start-up or scale-up

• 
Experience recruiting scientists or engineers, ideally internationally

• 
Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• 
Experience setting up HR processes or an applicant tracking system from scratch

• 
Experience with work permits for non-EU hires

• 
Experience working with external HR or recruitment partners

What we offer

• 
Working in a highly motivated team of passionate people at the forefront of photonic quantum technology

• 
Competitive salary + company paid pension

• 
Private health insurance

• 
Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• 
Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• 
Lunch subsidized by the company

• 
DSB Business Card

• 
Company phone and company credit card

• 
Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• 
Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• 
Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• 
Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• 
Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• 
Career Progression – Grow into project leadership, operations, or funding strategy based on your strengths

• 
Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Scroll down to submit your CV and a short cover letter in English.

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

•

Do you want to apply your data science skills to real business problems in a deep-tech scale-up?

As Sparrow Quantum grows, so does the data behind the business: customer and supplier records, orders, finance figures, and hiring data spread across spreadsheets and systems. Who we are looking for

You enjoy turning messy data into something people can rely on, and you would rather fix a process than repeat it. You are curious about how a company works across functions, and you can explain your work to colleagues without a technical background.

You have

• 
Enrollment in a bachelor's or master's program in data science or a related field, with at least 1.5 years of study left

• 
Experience with Python for data work, including pandas or similar libraries

What we offer

• 
Visible impact: the data flows, dashboards and automations you build will be used by the team every day, not filed away

A view of the whole company: insight into how a deep-tech scale-up works across R&D, production, sales and finance

Shaping your role: it is a new role, and you can help shape it

How to apply

Scroll down to submit your CV and a short cover letter in English. In the letter, describe one data or automation project you have worked on: the problem, what you built and what it changed. A GitHub link or a few sentences is enough.

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant – Actuarial Services, Financial Services Advisory
jobs.description:
Are you an actuary with a couple of years of experience looking to broaden your career beyond a traditional actuarial role? Would you like to work across insurance, audit and advisory, helping some of the largest financial institutions solve complex actuarial and business challenges?

Then you might be our new colleague in KPMG’s Financial Services Advisory team in Copenhagen.

The opportunity

We are looking for an ambitious actuary with approximately 2 years of relevant professional experience to strengthen our actuarial capabilities within Financial Services Advisory.

You will join a multidisciplinary team working with insurance companies and other financial institutions. Your assignments will vary from supporting our audit teams on actuarial matters to advising clients directly on actuarial, risk, regulatory and transformation topics.

The role provides a strong opportunity to combine your actuarial expertise with broader business and advisory experience and to develop your career in an environment where you will work closely with experienced colleagues, clients and specialists across KPMG.

What you will be doing

Depending on your experience and interests, your work may include:

• Performing actuarial analyses of insurance liabilities and technical provisions.

• Supporting the audit of insurance companies, including review and challenge of actuarial assumptions, methodologies, models and calculations.

• Working with Solvency II, financial reporting and other regulatory requirements relevant to insurers.

• Reviewing and challenging reserving methodologies, models, assumptions and data.

• Supporting actuarial modelling, validation and quantitative analyses.

• Advising insurance clients on improvements to their actuarial processes, governance, controls and documentation.

• Contributing to projects at the intersection of actuarial science, risk management, regulation, data and technology.

• Working directly with clients and gradually taking responsibility for your own workstreams and deliverables.

• Collaborating with colleagues across KPMG in Denmark and our international network.

The aim is not only for you to apply your actuarial skills, but also to develop into a trusted adviser who understands both the numbers and the business behind them.

Who we are looking for

We expect that you:

• Hold a relevant quantitative degree, ideally within actuarial mathematics, insurance mathematics or a closely related field.

• Have approximately 2 years of relevant experience, for example from an insurance company, consultancy or audit firm.

• Have practical experience with actuarial calculations, models or insurance liabilities.

• Have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy working with complex quantitative topics.

• Are interested in understanding the commercial, regulatory and strategic context surrounding actuarial work.

• Communicate clearly and are comfortable discussing your analyses with both specialists and non-specialists.

• Enjoy working collaboratively and taking responsibility.

• Are fluent in English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage.

Experience within life insurance, non-life insurance, pensions, reserving, Solvency II or actuarial audit would be particularly relevant, but we do not expect you to be an expert in all areas.

What we offer

At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to build a career that extends beyond a traditional actuarial role.

You will become part of Financial Services Advisory, where we bring together expertise across insurance, banking, risk, regulation, data, technology and transformation. You will work alongside experienced specialists while being given responsibility early in your career.

We offer:

• A steep learning curve and exposure to different insurance companies and business models.

• The opportunity to combine actuarial expertise with advisory and business skills.

• Direct interaction with clients and senior colleagues.

• Access to KPMG's Danish and international actuarial and financial-services network.

• Opportunities to work on projects beyond traditional actuarial assignments.

• A collaborative and informal environment with strong focus on professional and personal development.

Most importantly, we offer the opportunity to help shape and grow our actuarial capability in Financial Services Advisory.

Why KPMG?

You’ll thrive in a professional environment that emphasizes close team collaboration and cross-functional, international partnerships. You won’t just be a part of a team; You will become integral to a motivated and skilled team of over 60 international professionals driven by progression and professional development.

Our culture is not just a buzzword – It is social, informal, and open, with a flat organizational structure. We value diversity, social well-being, collaboration, and innovative thinking.

Interested?

If you find yourself aligned with this opportunity, then we are excited to get to know you better. Feel free to contact Senior Manager, Teis Dengsøe, tdengsoee@kpmg.com, or Partner Hans Jørgen Andresen, hansjandresen@kpmg.com. We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Help shape how KMD engages strategic accounts - connecting key societal agendas with customers’ strategic priorities through marketing advisory, customer insight and close collaboration with sales.

As Marketing Advisor, you will own marketing plans, campaigns and commercial communication from planning to execution on strategic accounts. Working with sales, subject-matter experts and corporate communication, you will position KMD as a strategic partner and create meaningful commercial conversations.

What you will do:

• Set the direction: develop the marketing strategy and annual plan for strategic accounts together with commercial stakeholders, based on customer needs and business priorities.

• Create demand: plan and execute integrated demand-generation activities across relevant channels.

• Make complex topics clear: translate technology, customer challenges and KMD’s capabilities into relevant messages and compelling value propositions.

• Work closely with sales: support strategic accounts and select sales opportunities with targeted account-based marketing throughout the buying journey.

• Learn from results: together with our Performance Specialist measure performance and use data, customer insights and commercial outcomes to improve activities.

What you bring:

You have minimum 3 years of B2B marketing experience and enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You are fluent in Danish and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

To succeed in this role, you bring:

• Experience translating customer and commercial priorities into marketing strategies, plans and integrated demand-generation campaigns.

• The ability to explain complex topics clearly and develop messages that show customers why a solution is relevant to them.

• An understanding of how marketing and sales work together to develop opportunities and move customer conversations forward.

• Experience with account-based marketing (ABM), pursuit marketing or bid marketing is an advantage.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to advise senior commercial colleagues while working collaboratively across teams.

• A structured, proactive approach, with the ability to prioritise and manage several initiatives while moving between planning and execution.

• Confidence in using AI tools responsibly to support your day-to-day work.

Experience in technology, IT, consulting, professional services or another complex solution environment.

Why join KMD?

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

This is an opportunity to shape the marketing approach for KMD’s strategic accounts and see your work connected directly with customer conversations and business priorities, while joining an ambitious marketing team that is developing how it contributes to KMD’s growth.

Interested? Let’s hear from you

Want to connect key societal agendas with customers’ strategic priorities through B2B marketing? We would love to hear from you.

Are you passionate about supporting colleagues offshore? Do you want to work in the green offshore wind industry where your skills and expertise will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then you might be the Crewing Coordinator we are looking for.

**Your Main Tasks Include

**

• Coordinate the booking of flights, rail tickets, hire cars and hotels for both vessel crew changes (and training courses where necessary).

• Assist the HR/ Head of Marine HR with the induction and initial documentation for offshore crew.

• Advise and support project and department manager’s resourcing needs.

• Aiding in internal and external audits when required

**To succeed in this role

We are looking for someone who can stay and work calmly in a high-pressure environment. You have a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and take pride in delivering tasks efficiently and to a high standard.

We think you will be a good match if you:

• Good knowledge of the Microsoft Office Package

• Strong communication skills and proficiency in English (written and spoken)

• Organised, structured and able to handle multiple priorities

**Why Cadeler?

**At Cadeler, we believe in building what matters. As part of a global team working in the offshore wind industry, you will contribute to projects that support the energy transition and help shape a more sustainable future.

We believe in trust, collaboration and shared responsibility. We give our people the opportunity to take ownership, develop their skills and grow together, while maintaining high standards in everything we do.

Join us and become part of a team where your contribution matters, your ideas are valued and we set the standard together.

**Come work with us!

**By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler has a global presence, with offices in Copenhagen, Vejle, Norwich, Rotterdam, and Taipei, alongside colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIVs).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

**Apply

**Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don’t hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible.

Please be aware, that if hired for the position the title will be Crewing Logistics Coordinator.

If you have any questions regarding the position or practical matters, please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

jobs.occupation: Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead, Operational Transformation, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead, Operational Transformation, Copenhagen

Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

Role and profile

The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

Organisation and reporting

You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering or Telecom Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience fiber types and their application, physical fiber characteristics, and standard testing tools (e.g., Optical Spectrum Analyzer (OSA), Bit Error Rate Tester (BERT), Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR)).

• Experience in telecommunications, carrier class optical network infrastructure, transmission systems, layer2/3 routers, and data services.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience with managing or directing field operation technicians, engineers, contractors or vendors in a Telco working environment.

• Experience in developing and implementing automation solutions for network deployment or similar processes.

• Experience with process improvement or process engineering methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

• Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, lead technical projects, prioritize and manage project timelines.

• Ability to travel up to 50% as necessary.

• Strong investigative and problem-solving skills, with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning. Denmark: kr.800000 - kr.820000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deliver Google's network reliably and at scale, with a focus on workflow automation and efficiency.

• Drive adaptable and scalable approaches, collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize network deployment cycle time and operational costs through process improvements.

• Manage an area of responsibility, addressing issues, anticipating needs and escalating as necessary, while identifying automation opportunities to improve efficiency and prevent reoccurring failure modes.

• Maintain accurate network data to drive operational excellence.

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

Vil du have fingrene i mulden, ansvar og masser af arbejdsglæde? 🌸🌱

Er du faglært gartner, og har du lyst til at blive en del af et moderne potteplantegartneri, hvor tempoet er højt, strukturen er flad, og humøret er i top? Vi vil styrke vores team, og vi glæder os til at byde en ny kollega velkommen på holdet i Odense!

Hos Gartneriet Møllerhøj handler det ikke bare om at passe planter – det handler om kvalitet i alt, hvad vi siger, gør og leverer til vores store kundekreds i hele Norden. Vores hjerte banker primært for hortensia, men vi forvandler også drivhusene til et farvehav af asters, julestjerner og diascia.

Hele vores produktion – lige fra de topmoderne drivhuse til vores frilandsarealer – er samlet på ét sted. Det betyder korte kommandoveje og en aktiv hverdag, hvor vi løfter i flok og har fart over feltet.

Hvem er du?

Du brænder for dit fag, og din faglighed er i top. Du er typen, der møder ind om morgenen med topmotivation og et ønske om at gøre en forskel – både for planterne og for dine kollegaer.

• 
Du er faglært gartner og har sprøjtecertifikat

• 
Du taler dansk eller engelsk – eller begge dele

• 
Du er stabil og pålidelig – vi kan regne med dig

• 
Du har kørekort B til almindelig bil

• 
Du vil være med til at tilføre dit bedste til både planter og arbejdsmiljø

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

Vi lover, at du ikke bare bliver "en i rækken". Vi tager imod dig med vores helt nye onboarding-strategi, så du får den absolut bedste oplæring og lander trygt i din nye rolle.

• 
Sammen med gartnerteamet vil du få ansvar for vanding, sprøjtning samt opgaver med biologi og gødning. Som et led i moderne drift vil du også komme til at arbejde med diverse registreringsopgaver.

• 
Gode kollegaer: Vi har en uhøjtidelig tone, en flad struktur og en rigtig god stemning. Vi prioriterer at samles til sociale arrangementer flere gange årligt.

• 
Attraktive vilkår: Løn, der svarer til dine kvalifikationer samt pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

Er det dig, vi mangler?

English:

We’re Hiring: Skilled Gardener

Do you love working with plants, getting your hands in the soil and taking responsibility? 🌸🌱

Are you an educated gardener looking to become part of a modern potted plant nursery with a fast-paced working environment, a flat organisational structure and a great team spirit? We are looking to strengthen our team, and we look forward to welcoming a new colleague to our team.

At Gartneriet Møllerhøj it’s not just about growing and caring for plants – it’s about delivering quality in everything we say, do and supply to our large customer base across the Nordic countries. Hydrangeas are at the heart of what we do, but we also transform our greenhouses into a sea of colour with asters, poinsettias and diascia.

Our entire production – from our state-of-the-art greenhouses to our outdoor growing areas – is located at one site. This means short lines of communication and an active working day where teamwork is key and things move quickly.

Who are you?

You are passionate about horticulture and take pride in your professional skills. You are the kind of person who arrives at work in the morning motivated and ready to make a difference – both for the plants and your colleagues.

• 
You are an educated gardener and hold a spraying certificate.

• 
You speak Danish or English – or both.

• 
You are reliable and dependable – someone we can count on.

• 
You hold a category B driving licence (car).

• 
You are committed to giving your best, both when it comes to the plants and contributing to a positive working environment.

What do we offer?

We promise that you won't just be another employee. We will welcome you with our new onboarding programme, ensuring you receive the best possible training and feel confident and comfortable in your new role.

• 
Responsibilities: Together with the gardening team, you will handle watering, spraying, biological plant protection, fertilisation and various registration tasks.

• 
Great colleagues: An informal workplace, a flat structure and a strong team spirit, with social events throughout the year.

• 
Attractive conditions: Salary based on qualifications, pension scheme and health insurance.

Working hours:

Monday: 06:30–15:00

Tuesday: 06:30–15:00

Wednesday: 06:30–13:45

Thursday: 06:30–14:45

Friday: 06:30–14:45

The position is 37 hours per week. During the busy spring season, we put in some extra hours, with a few weeks reaching 45 hours. Weekend duties are shared among the team, and as a general rule, you can expect to work approximately every third or fourth weekend.

Could you be the person we're looking for?

If you would like to help strengthen our team and play a part in maintaining our high standards of quality, we would love to hear from you!

We are looking for someone to start as soon as possible, and interviews will be held on an ongoing basis. So don't hesitate to send your CV and a few words about yourself to: maria@50008.dk

Questions about the position?

You are very welcome to contact Thomas Kjær Larsen on +45 28 14 95 13 for an informal chat.
